## ⚠️ 꼭 반영할 것
- 장소는 **고양 KINTEX**(일산서구). "Seoul downtown" / "서울 시내"로 쓰지 말 것. 공식 표기: KINTEX (Korea International Exhibition Center), 217-60 Kintex-ro, Ilsanseo-gu, Goyang-si, Gyeonggi-do 10390.
- korea.hyrox.com 소개 문구의 "2 full … days"는 무시. **hyrox.com/event/hyrox-seoul/** 기준 **3일**(금 13·토 14·일 15).
- **참가비·관람 티켓 가격은 쓰지 말 것**(공식 본문에 숫자 가격 없음).
- 주차(HYROX 공식): **₩3,720/hour** · **₩19,000 all-day**. "If you stay more than 5 hours, it is better to purchase an all day ticket."
- KINTEX 공식 요금표(HYROX가 HERE로 링크한 페이지): 승용·승합·2.5톤 미만 화물 기준 처음 20분 ₩1,240, 이후 10분당 ₩620, 일 최대 ₩19,000 — HYROX의 시간당 ₩3,720과 같은 계산. 유공자·장애인·경차·저공해 1·2종 50% 할인(중복 할인 없음). 입차 20분 이내 출차 무료. 임시주차장 T2/T3/T4는 "행사 규모에 따라 탄력 운영(상시 개방 아님)"이라 **이번 대회 개장 여부는 미확인 → 쓰지 말 것.**
- HYROX "getting to the venue" 링크는 https://www.kintex.com/ 홈이지 지하철 상세 안내가 아님. 대중교통은 KINTEX 공식 교통 페이지 기준으로만.
- 도보 시간·출구 번호는 공식 본문에 없음 → 만들지 말 것. "대화역에서 걸어 14분"도 오늘 확인하지 못함 → 쓰지 말 것.
- Flex 50% 환불: 일요일 레이서는 **11/8 07:59 KST**에 창이 닫힘. 저녁 게시(IG 19:00 등)에는 Flex 환불을 넣지 말 것. Lite Flex ≠ 환불(이름 변경만).
- 웨이브는 provisional / subject to change. **일요일 릴레이 시간이 1106 패킷과 달라짐**(아래 B). 11/8 메인 앵글은 가는 법·주차라 웨이브 전체를 카드에 넣지 않아도 됨.
- KINTEX·HYROX 페이지에 있는 **전화번호·이메일 절대 금지**. "MZ 사우나", RUNPORT, 효능·회복 단정 금지.

## 그대로 써도 되는 사실 (영어, 카드·Threads·X·Reddit용)

### A. Venue + parking + getting there (메인)
출처: https://hyrox.com/event/hyrox-seoul/ (오늘 재조회)
주차 상세(HYROX가 링크): https://www.kintex.com/web/en/service/parking_user.do
대중교통(KINTEX 공식): https://www.kintex.com/web/en/html/service/parking_transportation.do · 한국어 https://www.kintex.com/web/ko/html/service/parking_transportation.do
베뉴 맵(HYROX 공식 PDF): https://hyrox.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/13-15-November-1.pdf

1. **Event**: AirAsia HYROX Seoul | Season 26/27 · **Fri Nov 13 – Sun Nov 15, 2026** · KINTEX, Goyang (not downtown Seoul).
2. **Address**: KINTEX (Korea International Exhibition Center), 217-60 Kintex-ro, Ilsanseo-gu, Goyang-si, Gyeonggi-do 10390, South Korea.
3. **Parking (HYROX official)**: **₩3,720 per hour** · **₩19,000 all-day**. If you stay more than 5 hours, the all-day ticket is better.
4. **KINTEX official rate** (passenger cars, vans, freight under 2.5 tons): first 20 minutes ₩1,240, then ₩620 per 10 minutes, daily maximum ₩19,000. 50% discount for vehicles for persons of national merit, disability, compact cars, and low-emission (Type 1 and 2); no duplicate discounts. No parking fee if the vehicle exits within 20 minutes of entry.
5. **Driving (KINTEX official)**:
   - From central Seoul via Olympic Highway: Olympic Highway → Hangju Bridge → Jayu-ro → KINTEX IC (Isanpo IC) → KINTEX Road (Goyang-daero) → KINTEX
   - From central Seoul via Gangbyeon Expressway: Gangbyeon Expressway → Jayu-ro → KINTEX IC (Isanpo IC) → KINTEX Road (Goyang-daero) → KINTEX
   - From northern/southern Gyeonggi via 1st Circular Highway: 1st Circular Highway → Jayu-ro → KINTEX IC (Isanpo IC) → KINTEX Road → KINTEX
   - From Incheon/Gimpo Airport: Incheon International Airport Expressway → 1st Circular Highway (Hangju Bridge) → Jayu-ro (Bukno IC) → KINTEX IC (Isanpo IC) → KINTEX Road → KINTEX
   ("Seoul city center" on that page is the starting point, not a claim that KINTEX is downtown.)
6. **Rail (KINTEX official public-transport page)**: Their diagrams send visitors to **KINTEX Station (킨텍스역)**. Published transfer examples: Line 3 via Yeonsinnae → KINTEX Station; many other lines via Seoul Station or Daegok (대곡) → KINTEX Station; Gyeongui-Jungang and Seohae via Daegok → KINTEX Station; AREX via Gimpo Int’l Airport → Daegok → KINTEX Station. The same page also has a GTX section. Do not invent walking minutes or exit numbers.
7. **Buses KINTEX lists as serving the complex** (English official transport page):
   - **9703** (wide-area): KINTEX Exhibition Hall 2 ↔ Seoul Station, 05:00–23:00 both ends, every 25 minutes daily
   - **9711** (wide-area): KINTEX Exhibition Hall 2 ↔ Yangjae-dong, 04:50–23:30 both ends, every 18 minutes daily
   The HYROX venue map does not name Hall 1 vs Hall 2 → do not say the race is in Hall 2. Say these buses stop at KINTEX Exhibition Hall 2.
8. **Venue map** (official PDF): bag drop, changing room, race hall entrance/exit, spectator check-in, athlete registration, run course, recovery zone, viewing areas. No exhibition-hall number stated.
9. **Race-day registration** at KINTEX from 07:30 (registration closing 20:00 each day). Bring ID; checking in on behalf of others is not allowed. Your race wristband is valid only on your race day.
10. Extra “getting to the venue” link on the HYROX page goes to https://www.kintex.com/

### B. Sunday wave times — 변경 알림 (11/8 본문 필수는 아님, 이후 초안 수정용)
출처: 오늘 https://hyrox.com/event/hyrox-seoul/ 재조회. Fri·Sat 웨이브는 1106 패킷과 동일. Sunday relays changed:
- Relay Men: **17:50–18:30** (1106 패킷은 18:00–18:40)
- Relay Mixed: 19:00–19:50 (변동 없음)
- Relay Women: **20:20–20:30** (1106 패킷은 20:10–20:20)
공식 표기 *subject to change* 유지.
